history: A 1980s layered shot; the anise-and-cream pairing is older than the name.
whyItWorks: Anise and dairy should clash and instead read as almost liquorice ice cream.
steps: Pour the sambuca into a shot glass.
Layer by pouring each ingredient slowly over the back of a bar spoon so it floats on the one below.

substitutions.notes: Peppermint gives a different but comparable cream-and-spice effect.

name: Slippery Nipple
description: Sambuca with Irish cream floated on top.
